scope: Actual hosted PostgreSQL functions, triggers and role boundaries. Separate from REST SDK / full candidate HTTP / mobile acceptance.

checks.name: reviewed function definitions and service-only execution match
both synthetic owner IDs initially absent
explicit confirmation persists and advances source epoch
owner predicates block foreign correction and deletion
snapshot replay returns one exact owner revision
correction advances revision and rejects stale snapshot
deletion removes own memory, preserves other owner and rejects stale projection
context opening and replay persist one conversation and one source-bound message
foreign owner cannot replay an existing context operation
stale context source epoch is rejected
memory consent change invalidates prior source epoch
anon cannot read private memory or invoke RPC despite forged role claim
authenticated cannot read private memory or invoke RPC despite forged role claim

concurrency: Not measured in hosted transaction; prior 12-way native checks remain separate evidence
